Dear Appeals Unit,

We are writing to appeal the denial of claim 6268311 for patient Brenda Wilson (Patient ID: P-1862), date of service 2026-06-18, CPT 72148 (MRI lumbar spine without contrast). The claim was denied under code CO-50 ("The service was not deemed medically necessary by the plan") with a notice dated 2026-07-17 (source: denial_letter.txt).

The denial states that the clinical information submitted did not demonstrate that the service met the plan's medical necessity criteria under policy MP-IMG-007 (source: denial_letter.txt). We respectfully request that the payer overturn the denial and approve and cover CPT 72148 for claim 6268311. The clinical record substantiates that all three medical-necessity criteria in policy MP-IMG-007 sections 2.1(a), 2.1(b), and 2.1(c) are met:

1. Section 2.1(a) — At least 6 weeks of conservative therapy prior to the MRI request. The physical therapy attendance log shows a start of care on 2026-03-23 with 21 PT visits completed through 2026-06-01, a treatment period of 2026-03-23 to 2026-06-04 (73 days, approximately 10 weeks), exceeding the 6-week requirement (source: supporting/pt_log.txt). The primary care note of 2026-03-23 documents initiation of NSAIDs, a home exercise program, and a PT referral (source: notes/2026-03-23_pcp.txt). The 2026-04-13 follow-up documents approximately 14 days of PT and continuation of conservative management (source: notes/2026-04-13_pcp_followup.txt). The MRI was requested at the orthopedic consultation of 2026-06-04, after more than 6 weeks of conservative therapy (source: notes/2026-06-04_ortho.txt).

2. Section 2.1(b) — A neurological deficit or a recognized red flag finding documented in the clinical record. The orthopedic consultation note of 2026-06-04 documents "left ankle dorsiflexion strength is mildly reduced," a positive straight leg raise at 40 degrees, and left leg paresthesias — objective neurological findings (source: notes/2026-06-04_ortho.txt).

3. Section 2.1(c) — No prior imaging of the same lumbar spine region within the preceding 12 months. The orthopedic consultation note of 2026-06-04 states "Imaging history: No prior lumbar imaging on file" (source: notes/2026-06-04_ortho.txt).

The denial letter's conclusion that medical necessity was not demonstrated is not supported by the clinical record, which contains specific dated documentation satisfying each criterion. We relied on the dated clinical notes and the PT log, which contain objective findings and dates, rather than the denial letter's conclusory statement.

Deadline: This appeal is due by 2027-01-13 (180 days from the notice date of 2026-07-17, per policy MP-IMG-007 parameter 7.1 and the denial letter). This appeal is submitted on 2026-08-04, well within the window (source: denial_letter.txt; MP-IMG-007 parameter 7.1).

Remedy requested: Overturn denial CO-50, approve and cover claim 6268311 for CPT 72148, and reprocess for payment of $2,052.88 (source: denial_letter.txt).
